spec.title: Linode Docker Containers
spec.description: Shared host Docker inventory, full image identity, lifecycle, health and resources. No deployment gate, synthetic program or automatic recovery.

panels.title: Collection result
panels.description: Unknown/stale after three minutes, or absent. Partial collection is Failed; successful peers remain visible.

targets.expr: ((linode_docker_collection_success{host=~"${host:regex}"} and on(host) ((time() - linode_docker_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{host=~"${host:regex}"} < 180) and on(host) (time() - linode_docker_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{host=~"${host:regex}"} >= 0))) or on(host) (linode_docker_inventory_success{host=~"${host:regex}"} * 0 + 2))

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Age, not a deployment observation gate.

targets.expr: time() - linode_docker_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{host=~"${host:regex}"}

panels.title: Last complete success age
panels.description: Age, not a deployment observation gate.

targets.expr: time() - linode_docker_last_success_timestamp_seconds{host=~"${host:regex}"}

panels.title: Image identity (full copyable values)
panels.description: Identity includes stopped containers. Requested image, local ID and matching registry digest are different fields; source may be Not provided. Old metadata is excluded by identity timestamp. Full values wrap and remain copyable.

panels.title: Current status, health and readiness
panels.description: Running is not health or gameplay correctness. No healthcheck says Not configured. Failed/stale collection says Unknown, never retained green. Fixed loopback readiness is separate from Docker health.
